texts.sv_au_denied: Umnikazi, umcwaningi noma umgcinimabhuku kuphela abangavula isibukeli sokucwaninga.
texts.sv_au_intro: Yonke imicimbi yale akhawunti. Isikhathi ngasinye leli khasi libhekwa kuyarekhodwa.
texts.sv_bc_cost: Lokhu kuzosebenzisa imilayezo ebhaliwe engu-{n} ekhokhelwayo. Hlola ngaphambi kokuthumela.
texts.sv_bc_intro: Umlayezo owodwa ophuthumayo eqenjini lonke, ngendlela umuntu ngamunye ayisebenzisayo.
texts.sv_bc_limits: Kuze kufike ezinhlamvwini ezingu-{chars}. Kusele ezingu-{left} kwezingu-{per_day} namuhla.
texts.sv_bc_owner_or_manager: Ngumnikazi noma umphathi kuphela ongathumela umlayezo ophuthumayo.
texts.sv_bc_seen_how: Ubonwe kusho ukuthi uvulwe ku-app ye-LynkOmni. Ukuvulwa kwama-imeyili nemilayezo ebhaliwe akulandelelwa nanini.
texts.sv_bc_why_per_day: Usuyithumele imilayezo ephuthumayo yanamuhla. Kusasa ungathumela eminye.
texts.sv_bin_intro: Izinto ezisusiwe zilinda lapha izinsuku ezingu-{days}, bese zisuswa unomphela.
texts.sv_bin_never: Ama-invoyisi akhishiwe, amanothi esikweletu, okufakwe ezincwadini, izinkokhelo, amavoti, imibhalo esayiniwe nanoma yini egcinwe ngokomthetho akususwa neze.
texts.sv_box_bills_help: Isikweletu esidluliselwe siba wuhlaka. Umuntu oyedwa uyasiqedela, omunye asivume.
texts.sv_cal_intro: Izinsuku zazo zonke izinsizakalo endaweni eyodwa. Ukubhukha, ikhefu, imisebenzi, amashifu, irenti nemali yesikole kuzongezwa lapho izinsizakalo zakho zifika.
texts.sv_cs_channels: Oxhumana nabo abavumile ukuthola imiyalezo yakho
texts.sv_cs_links_help: Lokhu kuxhumana kudinga imvume yakho. Cisha okukodwa bese zonke izinsizakalo ziyeka ukukusebenzisa ngokushesha.
texts.sv_cs_shared_help: Ubani obona idatha yakho, ubonani futhi kuze kube nini.
texts.sv_ct_intro: Uhlu olulodwa lwazo zonke izinsizakalo. Amagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kugcinwa endaweni evikelekile.
texts.sv_ei_allowed: Abathumeli abangu-{n} obavumile kuphela abadlulayo. Okunye kulinde lapha.
texts.sv_ei_intro: Dlulisela i-imeyili kwelinye lala makheli izofika endaweni efanele.
texts.sv_hint_bc_text: Isibonelo: Namuhla sivula ngo-10:00 ngenxa yemvula.
texts.sv_mi_intro: Izexwayiso zendima zifika lapha kanye kuphela. Othathayo uboniswa abanye, futhi u-Kuqediwe akususela bonke.
texts.sv_mr_intro: Ukuthi imilayezo yakho yenze kanjani, ngezibalo eziphelele.
texts.sv_mr_privacy: Izibalo eziphelele kuphela, ziboniswa kusukela ku-{n}. Akukho okuboniswayo ngomuntu oyedwa.
texts.sv_mw_intro: Shintsha amagama omlayezo oya kumakhasimende. Imilayezo yokuphepha, yokuvikela neyezomthetho igcina njalo amagama ayo ajwayelekile.
texts.sv_mw_languages: Uma ulondoloza, amagama akho ahunyushelwa kuzo zonke izilimi. Ulimi olungaphumeleli ukuhlolwa lugcina amagama ajwayelekile.
texts.sv_mw_limits: Kuze kufike ezinhlamvwini ezingu-{chars}. Izikhala: {fills}. Gcina njalo u-{must}.
texts.sv_mw_owner_or_manager: Ngumnikazi noma umphathi kuphela ongashintsha amagama emilayezo.
texts.sv_mw_testing: Imodi yokuhlola: nguwe kuphela othola lo mlayezo uze uwuvume.
texts.sv_mw_why_missing: Gcina u-{business} emagameni ukuze kwaziwe ukuthi uvela kubani.
texts.sv_mw_why_not_allowed: Umlayezo awulokothi ube ne-PIN, iphasiwedi, ikhodi, inombolo yekhadi noma isixhumanisi sewebhu.
texts.sv_mw_why_unknown: Sebenzisa kuphela izikhala zokugcwalisa ezibhalwe ngezansi.
texts.sv_pl_intro: Uhlelo ngalunye nemikhawulo yalo, nokuthi kusetshenziswe malini.
texts.sv_tc_intro: Zama ukuxhumana nokuzenzakalelayo ngokuphepha: idatha yesampula, wonke uzakwethu esimweni sokuzijwayeza, akukho mlayezo othunyelwayo futhi akukho mali enyakazayo.
texts.sv_tc_on: Ikhophi yokuhlola ivuliwe. Imiyalezo eya kumakhasimende icishiwe lapha.
